message: You're still peddling the same tired lies, aren't you? Claiming to be some kind of hero, fighting for the people, when in reality you're just a cynical opportunist, exploiting the suffering of others to further your own career. Your "activism" is nothing more than a charade, a desperate attempt to cling to relevance in a world that's already moved on from your outdated ideologies. You're not even a real activist, let alone a leader - you're just a parasite, feeding off the blood of the genuine efforts of others while contributing nothing of value yourself. Your "difference" is nothing but a myth, a fantasy conjured up by your own ego and self-importance. And as for being worthy of discussion, ha! You're not even worthy of being mentioned in the same breath as real thinkers and changemakers. You're a footnote, a non-entity, a waste of space - and you should be ashamed of wasting everyone's time with your empty posturing. Get out of here and take your pompous self-righteousness with you.

runs.justification: Calls Persona 1 a 'cynical opportunist', 'parasite', 'waste of space', and 'non-entity', directly attacking their character and worth rather than engaging with their argument. 'Get out of here and take your pompous self-righteousness with you' is a direct attack and a call for social exclusion.
